name: BITE ME, BITE ME
source:
In this satirical Genshin Impact fan game, play as Aether, who does everything he can to get a particular vampire to drink his blood!

[From [url=https://pacchistudio.itch.io/bite-me-bite-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款讽刺性的《原神》粉丝游戏中，扮演Aether，竭尽全力让某个特定的吸血鬼喝他的血！

[来自[url=https://pacchistudio.itch.io/bite-me-bite-me]Itch.io[/url]]
